Anika: replaying tenant-42 snapshot smoke test failed: manifest sha256 != computed sha256 :rotating_light:
Mike: quick details? file size / gzip header look normal?
Anika: sizes identical. Manifest (snapshots/tenant42/2026-03-20/manifest.json) lists sha256=3b7f...ea9c but downloaded tar.gz hashes to a9d2...1f33. I pulled from backups-prod bucket.
Sara: Could be a metadata loss during lifecycle re-encrypt, or uploader wrote wrong manifest. Any object metadata?
Anika: head-object shows x-amz-meta-sha256: 3b7f...ea9c and x-amz-meta-cmk-id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/old-cmk. However lifecycle encryptor ran on 2026-03-21.
Javier: If lifecycle copy replaced bytes but preserved old metadata, mismatch possible. Or copy replaced bytes and dropped metadata so head-object returned stale metadata value from manifest. Which version is current vs prior?
encops-bot: Alert created ENCOPS-4321: snapshot-integrity-check failed for tenant-42 (snap-20260320-42).
Mike: Steps: (1) pause lifecycle for tenant42 prefix, (2) check S3 versioning for previous versions, (3) fetch head-object (ETag/VersionId) and compare.
Anika: Paused lifecycle for s3://backups-prod/snapshots/tenant42/. head-object returned VersionId: null (but bucket has versioning ON, I'm pulling list-object-versions). Downloaded current object and ran `sha256sum` -> a9d2...1f33 (mismatch).
Javier: I'll inspect encryptor-daemon logs & code path for CopyObject. Recent deploy changed metadata handling?
Sara: Also check CloudTrail for kms:Decrypt/GenerateDataKey operations near the copy time. If encryptor switched SSE-C->SSE-KMS path it might have re-encrypted bytes incorrectly. Run: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=CopyObject --start-time 2026-03-20 --end-time 2026-03-22`
Mike: Assigning: Anika restore prior version if present (ETA 30m), Javier checks encryptor-daemon (hotfix if needed), Sara scans KMS grant/rotate events. I'll escalate to infra on failure to find a good version.
Anika: Found prior version id v-0a1b2c; its sha256 matches manifest (3b7f...ea9c). Current head is a later object that differs. I've kept a local copy of both.
encops-bot: ENCOPS-4321 updated: lifecycle paused (by Anika).
Mike: Plan: restore prior version as authoritative artifact and run a small restore to verify end-to-end. Also add a post-copy verification step in encryptor-daemon to validate sha metadata vs computed. Javier: any quick patch?
Javier: encryption-daemon v2.2 introduced a metadata map overwrite when rotating CMK 5, causing MetadataDirective=REPLACE and an empty map. I can push a 2-line fix to preserve existing x-amz-meta-sha256 and set MetadataDirective=COPY when present. PR in 18m.
Sara: I'll check KMS grants and list-grants for alias/backup-encrypt-key to ensure no grant pruning happened recently. Also adding a CloudTrail note to ENCOPS-4321.
Anika: Restored prior version using CopyObject with MetadataDirective=COPY and ran `sha256sum` on the restored file against manifest -> match. Kicking automated replay test now.
Mike: Good. Follow-ups: (a) ship encryptor-daemon fix + canary, (b) add pre/post-copy checksum verification and fail if mismatch, (c) add alert for metadata/content mismatch on snapshot-integrity-check.
encops-bot: ENCOPS-4321 assigned to encops, priority P2.
Anika: Replay smoke passed after restore. Leaving lifecycle paused until encryptor-daemon fix deployed to prod.
Mike: Thanks all. Keep notes in ENCOPS-4321 and update runbook for CopyObject metadata pitfalls. Ping if any regressions. :thumbsup:
